pages.speaker: npc
lines: Hello. Lovely weather isn't it? It's so pleasant.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: ...Oh dear... I must have dozed off. Welcome. My name is Erika. I am the Leader of Celadon Gym.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I teach the art of flower arranging. My Pokémon are of the grass-type.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that you wished to challenge me. Very well, but I shall not lose.
input: !q.is_blank(v.advancement) ? q.run_command('/execute at @e[type=marker,tag=leader_erika,limit=1,sort=nearest] run tp ' + q.player.username() + ' ~ ~ ~ facing entity ' + q.npc.uuid() );

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong. I must confer you the Rainbow Badge.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Please also take this with you.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: TM19 contains Giga Drain. Half the damage it inflicts is drained to heal your Pokémon. Wouldn't you agree that it's a wonderful move?

pages.speaker: npc
lines: You are cataloging Pokémon? I must say I'm impressed. I would never collect Pokémon if they were unattractive.
